Strict iid equality follows from independence plus equal positive amplitudes.

value.rationale: The all-prefix majorization describes which singular directions benefit or lose from changing the amplitude distribution, providing a simultaneous performance guarantee for every monotone spectral objective rather than a single average residual number. The exact convergent pair sum quantifies the cost of exchangeable amplitude variance in each pair of singular modes and remains valid for cylindrical infinite-dimensional sketches. This directly addresses a natural distribution-selection and spectral-allocation question in recent Hilbert--Schmidt randomized SVD literature, with a nontrivial three-mode rational witness.
